audit.claim: Whether every label-shuffled fit's test accuracy is practically equivalent to chance (inside the registered band) while every intact-label baseline fit is adequate (above the registered floor), conditional on each fitted model and the shared test sample. The paired baseline-versus-shuffled comparison is reported as a secondary, non-gating endpoint.
audit.name: Controlled Perturbation Audit

progression_criterion.rule: every perturbed fit stops at the starting round with no best_round, and every baseline fit passes at least its starting round (best_round is not None)

autond_pipeline_progression.rule: upstream train_neural_distinguisher: stop when a round's max val_acc <= 0.505; best_round is the last round above it (None if the first round stops)

dataset.generation_procedure: main.make_train_data at the pinned commit: one call per registered round for train and validation, one comparison-round call for test, persisted at preflight

bootstrap_ci_mean_difference.role: descriptive only; not used by the decision

interpretation: The registered evidence establishes neither a successful control (every shuffled fit near chance and every baseline adequate) nor a failure (a shuffled fit outside the band, or a baseline below the floor). This is not evidence of near-chance behaviour.
limitations: Label shuffling is a blunt control: it removes genuine signal and label-correlated artifacts together. Near-chance accuracy does not show that no leakage of any form exists; targeted generation-order and label-leakage checks are a separate, complementary audit not performed here.

Inference is conditional on each fitted model and assumes test rows i.i.d. from the generator, independent of training. It is a statement about these k fits per condition, not a population estimate over training seeds; seed-to-seed variance is not estimated by any confidence bound here.
The chance reference 0.5 assumes labels are fair coin flips independent of the features under the generator; observed test class counts and class-conditional rates are descriptive only.
The baseline adequacy floor is a registered practical tolerance below the published 5-round benchmark, not a value prescribed by Gohr or by the audit methodology.

baseline_procedure.estimand: per intact-label baseline fit: test accuracy q_r of the reloaded selected model, conditional on that model
baseline_procedure.sampling_model: same test rows and binomial model as the near-chance endpoint

overall_rule.SUPPORTED: otherwise, near-chance endpoint SUPPORTED and baseline-adequacy gate PASSED

primary_procedure.estimand: per perturbed fit: test accuracy p_r of the reloaded selected model, conditional on that model
primary_procedure.sampling_model: test rows i.i.d. from make_train_data (labels independent urandom bits, class counts not fixed); X_r ~ Binomial(n, p_r) given the model

supporting_procedure.discordance: b = baseline wrong & perturbed right; c = baseline right & perturbed wrong
supporting_procedure.estimand: per replicate: delta_r = acc(perturbed_r) - acc(baseline_r) = (b - c) / n on the same test rows

methodology.unit_of_inference: each fitted model, conditional on it; the k fits per condition share one test sample and are never pooled or treated as independent test sets

not_recomputed: without --rerun-models, that the persisted predictions are what the selected checkpoint outputs (only checkpoint and prediction digests are checked)
the training itself: TensorFlow training is not bitwise reproducible, so fits are not re-trained
the data generator's assumptions (i.i.d. rows, fair labels), which are D3's subject
recomputed_from_persisted_evidence: per-fit correct counts, class-conditional counts and McNemar (b, c), from the persisted raw predictions and the test labels
every p-value, bound, interval, per-fit state, endpoint and gate result and the overall outcome, from those counts
the test partition, by its SHA-256 and canonical digest recorded at preflight
the identity of each selected checkpoint, by SHA-256, and its validation-loss selection history
with verify --rerun-models: that each reloaded selected checkpoint reproduces its persisted thresholded test predictions exactly

overlap_audit.key_scheme: bit-packed if binary else raw bytes; uint64 when <= 8 bytes else void

train.layout: round-major concatenation of the train_rRR partitions
